31700-C.s: This bill fixes the 2009 budget statement of the Provinciefonds, setting the commitment amount for general grants at 1,274,030,000 euros and the budget figures in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2009 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for general grants is fixed for grant year 2009 at 1,274,030,000 euros.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2009 vastgesteld op € 1 274 030 000.

31838-(R1874).s: The bill is a Rijkswet approving the 2003 Additional Protocol to the Cybercrime Convention, which criminalises racist and xenophobic acts committed via computer systems. It has two articles: approval for the whole Kingdom, and entry into force the day after Staatsblad publication.
q: is approved for the entire Kingdom
wordt goedgekeurd voor het gehele Koninkrijk

parties: Asks whether case law on Holocaust denial under art. 137c Sr is sufficient to meet the protocol's obligations on genocide denial.
Is such a ban based on case law sufficient to meet the obligations arising from this protocol?
Is een dergelijk verbod op basis van jurisprudentie voldoende om aan de verplichtingen voortvloeiend uit dit protocol te voldoen?
Worries the protocol may restrict legislature and courts in setting limits on freedom of expression and asks whether the Dutch declaration and reservation on art. 6 can be changed without parliament.
To what extent does this protocol restrict the Dutch legislator and judge in setting the limits of freedom of expression?
In hoeverre beperkt dit protocol de Nederlandse wetgever en rechter bij het vaststellen van de grenzen van de vrijheid van meningsuiting?
Questions the government's undefined notion of 'goede zeden' as a ground for limiting free speech, which it sees as subjective.
Asks whether criminal conduct under the protocol is actually punishable under Dutch law or depends on judicial interpretation, and argues clear legislation is needed for criminal law.
Does the government share the view that the Dutch law itself must first and foremost be clear, especially where criminal law is concerned?
Deelt de regering de opvatting dat eerst en vooral de Nederlandse wet zelf duidelijk dient te zijn, zeker indien het gaat om strafrecht?

31872-(R1876).s: The bill approves for the whole Kingdom the 1996 Protocol amending the 1976 Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims, with a reservation excluding certain wreck-removal claims and HNS damage. It also denounces the 1976 Convention for the Netherlands and states that later limit adjustments under the Protocol need no parliamentary approval.
31872-(R1876).j: The memorandum explains that the amendment procedure is treated like the limit amendments under the Protocol and that the national limits set by Royal Decree follow the same system, without detailing a separate justification for the parliamentary exemption.
q: Adjustments of the liability limits of the Protocol referred to in article 1, made in accordance with article 8 of the Protocol, do not require the approval of the States General.
Aanpassingen van de aansprakelijkheidsgrenzen van het in artikel 1 genoemde Protocol, tot stand gekomen overeenkomstig artikel 8 van het Protocol, behoeven niet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal.
d: adjustments of liability limits under Protocol article 8
p: Adjustments of the liability limits made under Protocol article 8 do not require approval by the States General.

parties: The SP asks about the maximum compensation payable to passengers and the status of the Protocol for Aruba, without raising a check concern.
What is now the maximum amount that can be paid to a passenger (or their surviving relatives) in case of injury or death?
Wat is nu het maximale bedrag dat aan een passagier (of zijn/haar nabestaanden) kan worden uitgekeerd in geval van letselschade of schade door overlijden?
The VVD questions whether amounts can be changed automatically without the Staten-Generaal having judged the change, and asks whether parliament should approve amendments and influence Dutch voting.

Furthermore, these members ask whether it would not be better to have changes to the amounts approved by the States General and whether the States General has influence over the vote the Netherlands will cast.

Voorts vragen deze leden of het niet beter is om wijziging van de bedragen toch door de Staten-Generaal te laten goedkeuren en of de Staten-Generaal invloed hebben op de stem die Nederland zal uitbrengen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised approval of the 1996 Protocol amending the 1976 limitation of liability convention for maritime claims, but recommended promoting its application in all parts of the Kingdom, including Aruba. The minister agreed and noted that the Aruban government had not yet replied on whether it wishes the Protocol to apply there.
concerns: The Afdeling advised that the Protocol should also apply to Aruba given the Kingdom's interest in international uniformity of maritime liability limits, and the minister agreed in principle but Aruba has not yet responded.

32123-C.s: The bill sets the 2010 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), fixing commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants in euros. It takes effect on 1 January 2010 and is enacted with Council of State advice and joint consultation of the States-General.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant etc. is set for the 2010 disbursement year at EUR 1,250,350,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2010 vastgesteld op € 1 250 350 000.

32222-C.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and the commitment amounts for general and integration/decentralisation grants. It takes effect from 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where published late.
q: We ... have resolved ... The budget of expenditure and revenue of the provinciefonds for 2009 is amended
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd

32360-XVII.s: The bill sets the 2009 supplementary budget changes (slotwetmutaties) for the Ministry of Youth and Families, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenues across policy articles. It also allows the 2009 annual report to depart from certain reporting requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as part of a pilot to improve political accountability.
32360-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the departures from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as necessary for an experiment agreed with the Tweede Kamer to improve political accountability.
q: For the experiment it is necessary for the relevant years to depart from a number of provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the annual report.
Ten behoeve van het experiment is het noodzakelijk voor de betreffende jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen in de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van het jaarverslag.

32500-D.s: The bill formally adopts the 2011 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (economic structure enhancement fund), setting its receipts at the level in article 21 of the statement and expressed in thousands of euros. It deviates from the Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking by allowing the fund to contribute in 2011 to other government budgets for nationally important investment projects in transport, technology and knowledge, energy sustainability, water management and spatial investment.
32500-D.j: The text provides no memorandum justification for the deviation in article 4 beyond the stated aim of strengthening the economic structure.
q: Notwithstanding article 3, first paragraph, part a, points 1 to 5 of the Fonds economische structuurversterking Act, in budget year 2011 contributions may be granted from the fund to other government budgets.

In afwijking van artikel 3, eerste lid, onderdeel a, onder 1° tot en met 5° van de Wet Fonds economische structuurversterking, kunnen in het begrotingsjaar 2011 ten laste van het fonds bijdragen worden toegekend aan andere begrotingen van het Rijk
p: Article 4 lets the fund finance other government budgets for investment projects in listed policy areas, departing from the enumerated uses in the fund statute for 2011, though the areas are named and limited to nationally important projects.

32710-A.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund through a third supplementary budget (slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across infrastructure items. It is a technical budget adjustment with no new delegation of rule-making power.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting-related changes or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33000-H.s: The bill formally adopts the 2012 budget statement of the BES-fonds (the fund financing the public bodies Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) in thousands of euros. It also allows the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations to publish the overview of special grants in an annex to the explanatory memorandum instead of under the usual rule of the Wet financiën openbare lichamen.
q: Notwithstanding article 94 of the Wet financiën openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba, the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations publishes the overview of special grants in an annex to the explanatory memorandum.

In afwijking van artikel 94 van de Wet financiën openbare lichamen Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba publiceert Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties het overzicht van de bijzondere uitkeringen in een bijlage bij de memorie van toelichting

33240-B.s: This supplementary budget act (slotwet) amends the 2011 expenditure and commitment amounts of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the final commitment figures for general, integration and decentralisation grants. It records a set of small mutations such as compensation for the NIK and funding for a school experiment, with no new executive powers.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2011 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this act.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2011 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

33514-(R1998).s: The bill amends the Dutch Nationality Act so that the concepts of 'father' and 'mother' are replaced by 'parent' (ouder), allowing the female partner of a mother to acquire parental status for nationality purposes outside adoption. It mainly aligns nationality law with a companion bill (33 032) on legal parenthood of the second mother.
33514-(R1998).j: The memorandum justifies the changes as following from the proposed civil-code change on legal parenthood, so that the child acquires Dutch nationality immediately at birth or recognition.
q: The advantage for the second mother and the child of the proposed amendment to the RWN is that the minor child immediately acquires Dutch nationality at the moment of birth or recognition under article 3(1) and article 4(2) RWN.

Het voordeel voor de duomoeder en het kind van de thans voorgestelde wijziging van de RWN is dat het minderjarige kind op grond van artikel 3 lid 1 RWN en artikel 4 lid 2 RWN het Nederlanderschap onmiddellijk verkrijgt op het moment van geboorte respectievelijk erkenning.

parties: Asks when a Civil Code change on legal parenthood will come and whether the nationality law must also be amended given the neutral wording.
They ask within what period the House can expect a legislative change regulating the legal parenthood of the mother's female registered partner on the basis of descent law.
Zij vragen op welke termijn de Kamer een wetswijziging kan verwachten die het juridisch ouderschap van de vrouwelijke geregistreerde partner van de moeder op basis van het afstammingsrecht regelt.

Welcomes the bill as a breakthrough for lesbian parent couples and urges the government to proceed quickly, and asks that the promised research into multi-parent families cover all family-law aspects rather than only custody.
These members regard this as a breakthrough in the equal treatment of lesbian parent couples and their children.
Deze leden achten dit een doorbraak in de gelijkberechtiging van lesbische ouderparen en hun kinderen.

Opposes the underlying Civil Code bill, questions whether this bill is truly necessary, and raises concerns about children acquiring multiple nationalities, confusing terminology and international consequences.
They consider it important that a child has as far as possible a father and a mother.
Zij vinden het belangrijk dat een kind zoveel mogelijk een vader en een moeder heeft.

34475-XVI.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (Slotwet) that amends the 2015 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport and the budgets of its agencies, adjusting spending and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It has no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers, and no accompanying explanatory memorandum text.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35210-C.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by raising the commitment amounts for general grants and setting the integration and decentralisation grant amounts. It takes effect from 1 June 2019, retroactively if the Staatsblad publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2019;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2019;

35300-C.s: This bill sets the 2020 budget of the provinciefonds, the fund that distributes money from the national government to the provinces, at about 2.48 billion euros in both expenditure and receipts. It fixes the commitment amounts for the general grant (2.276 billion euros) and for integration and decentralisation grants (204.3 million euros) under the Financiële-verhoudingswet.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for the 2020 grant year at € 2,276,013,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2020 vastgesteld op € 2.276.013.000.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft 2020 budget statute for the Provinciefonds and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) only transmits this blanket advice and notes that some budgets need amendments listed in annexes.

35850-XIX.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget of the National Growth Fund (XIX) by changing expenditure and commitment figures across policy articles and the fund's administration, and removes two words from article 1 of the original budget law. The bill contains no delegation of rule-making power and no accompanying explanatory memorandum was found in the text.
q: The budget statement of the National Growth Fund (XIX) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Nationaal Groeifionds (XIX) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35975-VIII.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (second supplementary budget) and the budget statement for agency DUO, adjusting appropriations, expenditure, receipts and investment figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 December 2021.
q: The budget statements are set in thousands of euros.
De vastelling van de begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

36120-B.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2022 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), raising commitments and expenditure by about 1.9 billion euros and 2.16 billion euros respectively, and sets the commitment amounts for the general grant, integration grants and decentralisation grants. The explanatory memorandum lists the individual integration and decentralisation grants and their amounts for 2022.
q: Amendment of the 2022 budget of the municipal fund
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2022

36200-C.s: This bill fixes the 2023 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at €2,996,423 thousand, with the general grant commitment set at €2,943,285,000 and integration and decentralisation grants at €0 and €53,038,000. It enters into force on 1 January 2023, or retroactively from that date if published later.
36200-C.j: The explanatory extract cites parliamentary motions asking the government to set rules ensuring compliance and to examine an emergency or solidarity fund for subnational governments, but gives no justification for delegated powers.
q: Requests the government to set further rules to ensure compliance with the two laws, so that it is demonstrable and verifiable for the House of Representatives that these laws are complied with.
Verzoekt de regering om, nadere regels te stellen ten behoeve van naleving van de twee wetten, zodat het ook voor de Tweede Kamer aantoonbaar en controleerbaar is dat deze wetten worden nageleefd

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no remarks on the draft 2023 Provincial Fund budget bill and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36410-XVII.s: This is the 2024 budget bill (begrotingswet) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII), setting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros for its policy articles. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes spending priorities including export control of strategic goods, youth and vocational/higher education, and an asylum-related budget contribution.
q: Adopted budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2024
Vastgestelde begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2024

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2024 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) and raised no substantive objections, offering only drafting remarks to align the bill text with the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving and the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, and to align the bill text with the explanatory notes. The government's reply (nader rapport) is not included in the text.
concerns: The bill text should be brought in line with the Aanwijzingen voor de regelgeving and the requirements of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016, and the bill text and article-by-article explanation should be aligned with each other.

36725-XIV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 budget statements of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature, the agencies budget (including the NVWA), and the Animal Health Fund, retroactive to 1 June 2025. It mainly reallocates funds for nitrogen measures in agriculture, manure policy, grassland subsidies and inspection, with no new legal powers for the executive.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature (XIV), of the agencies budget statement of this ministry and of the Animal Health Fund budget statement, all for the year 2025.

Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Visserij, Voedselzekerheid en Natuur (XIV), van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie en van de begrotingsstaat van het begrotingsfonds Diergezondheidsfonds (F), alle voor het jaar 2025.

36725-XVI.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, adjusting expenditure and commitment appropriations across policy articles. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 1 June 2025.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have approved and resolved ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (XVI) for the year 2025 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (XVI) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd
